content: 1. Natizia (dienogest/estradiol valerate) should be taken orally as one tablet daily at the same time each day, following the precise order indicated on the blister pack. Tablets should not be skipped, and intake should not be delayed by more than 12 hours. Initiate the regimen on the first day of the menstrual cycle and use a nonhormonal contraceptive backup method (e.g., condoms and foam) during the first 9 days of use. 2. The safety and efficacy of Natizia have been established in women of reproductive age. Its efficacy is expected to be similar in postpubertal adolescents under 18 years of age as in users aged 18 years and older. Adolescents requiring contraception should follow the same dosing instructions as adults. 3. Bosentan decreases the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate by inducing hepatic/intestinal enzyme CYP3A4 metabolism. This combination is contraindicated. Women should not use estradiol valerate/dienogest as contraception while taking strong CYP3A4 inducers due to the potential for reduced contraceptive efficacy. Estradiol valerate/dienogest should not be used for at least 28 days after discontinuing the inducer. 4. Women should avoid using estradiol valerate/dienogest as contraception while on strong CYP3A4 inducers. The contraceptive should not be used for at least 28 days after stopping the inducer. 5. Tranexamic acid and dienogest/estradiol valerate increase each other's toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergism. This combination is contraindicated. Co-administration increases thrombotic risk. 21. Belzutifan reduces the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate by inducing CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Women of reproductive potential should use effective nonhormonal contraception, as belzutifan may cause fetal harm. 22. Brigatinib decreases the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Women should use effective nonhormonal contraception during treatment and for at least 4 months after the last dose. 23. Calaspargase pegol may indirectly interact with oral contraceptives. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Use a non-oral contraceptive method for females of childbearing potential. 24. Dienogest/estradiol valerate reduces the efficacy of elagolix through pharmacodynamic antagonism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Women should use nonhormonal contraception during treatment and for 1 week after discontinuing elagolix. 25. Encorafenib decreases the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Women should use highly effective nonhormonal contraception during treatment and for 2 weeks after the final dose. 26. Lesinurad decreases the efficacy of dienogest/estradiol valerate via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Use additional nonhormonal contraception methods. 28. Lumacaftor/ivacaftor reduces the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate through an unspecified mechanism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Hormonal contraceptives are not reliable during co-administration. 29. Mavacamten decreases the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Patients should use contraception unaffected by CYP450 induction during treatment and for 4 months after the last dose. 30. Omaveloxolone reduces the efficacy of hormonal contraceptives due to weak CYP3A4 induction. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 31. Pexidartinib increases the risk of hepatotoxicity when co-administered with dienogest/estradiol valerate. Avoid or use an alternative drug. 32. Pretomanid increases the risk of hepatotoxicity when co-administered with dienogest/estradiol valerate. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Avoid alcohol and hepatotoxic agents. 33. Repotrectinib decreases the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Women should use effective nonhormonal contraception. 34. Sugammadex sodium reduces the efficacy of dienogest/estradiol valerate by receptor binding competition. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Use additional nonhormonal contraception for 7 days after administration. 35. Tovorafenib decreases the levels or effects of dienogest/estradiol valerate via CYP3A4 metabolism. Avoid or use an alternative drug.
